This year, the equinox occurs at 10:46 AM ET on March 20—just about now! Meteorological spring has us beat; it began on March 1 to match temperature cycles and simplify climate statistical comparison. .Either way, how do you plan to celebrate the start of springtime? We propose doing some spring cleaning and enjoy the plethora of fresh produce that this season is sure to provide.
